描述_EN: the v&a was a pioneer in the study of east asian metalwork when it bought this object from the parisian art dealer siegfried bing in 1876. at that time historians knew very little about chinese ritual bronzes. when these bronze vessels were accidentally unearthed centuries later they became treasured objects of antiquarian scholars and collectors. each vessel had a specific name according to its shape and function. the vessels were buried with the dead. in ancient china metalworkers made a great variety of food and wine containers in bronze for ritual use. the chinese name for this bronze wine vessel is fangzun.
描述_ZN: V&A是研究东亚金属制品的先驱，它在1876年从巴黎艺术品经销商西格弗里德-宾那里购买了这件物品。 当时历史学家对中国的青铜礼器知之甚少。 当这些青铜器在几百年后意外出土时，它们成为了古董学者和收藏家的珍品。 每个容器根据其形状和功能都有一个特定的名字。 年，这些器皿被与死者埋在一起。 在古代中国，金属工人用青铜制造了大量的食物和酒的容器，供祭祀使用。 这种青铜酒器的中文名称是方尊。
